title: 你的

series.next: Sunday dinner. For real this time. 林老师 will be in the kitchen, taking notes.

setting: 彩排工作室, Saturday, 10 am. Your parents' living room again, full size. Sunday dinner is tomorrow.

lin.name: 林老师
lin.en: runs the studio; has never smiled

xiaohuang.name: 小黄
xiaohuang.en: plays your mother today, in the apron

steps.narr: 老黄 and 小黄 arrive together, a little shy, with one umbrella.

else.en: You trust me more, don't you?

steps.zh: 你爸，由老黄演。你妈，由小黄演。
steps.en: Your father: 老黄. Your mother: 小黄.

steps.narr: 小黄 ties on the apron, very seriously. 老黄 opens a newspaper.

steps.en: You're home! You've lost weight! Eat!

say.en: Tell them both: you've quit your job.
say.gloss: Mum, Dad, I've quit my job.
say.tip: 辞职 cízhí = quit your job. You said it in episode 2; now it's both of them.

answers: 爸妈，跟你们说件事，我辞职了。
3.gloss: Mum, Dad, there's something I need to tell you: I've quit.

say.en: Explain: you want to open your own shop.
say.gloss: I want to open my own shop.
say.tip: 自己 zìjǐ = yourself, your own. 开店 = open a shop.

ok.en: A shop?... What kind of shop?

fail.en: Then what are you going to do?

1.gloss: I want to open a shop.

answers: 我想自己开店，计划都做好了。
我想自己开个店，计划都做好了。
3.gloss: I want to open my own shop. The plan's all worked out.

say.en: Dodge it, the way you did in episode 2.
say.gloss: We'll talk about it when the time comes.
say.tip: 到时候再说 = we'll see when we get there. Your own line from episode 2.

answers: 妈，这事不急，到时候再说吧。
3.gloss: Mum, there's no hurry. We'll see when the time comes.

steps.narr: The warehouse door. A woman in a good coat, holding a bag of oranges. Your mum. Your real one.

steps.en: 林老师 asked me to come.

steps.zh: 我也在练。练怎么听你说。
steps.en: I've been rehearsing too. Rehearsing how to listen to you.

say.en: Tell her for real, or ask to rehearse once more.
say.tip: The same three words, for real this time.

ok.zh: 我知道。你辞职那天，我就知道了。
ok.en: I know. I knew the day you did it.
This shop. Do you need money?

then.en: Your mother will be played by your mother. Begin.

fail.en: What do you want to say? I'm listening.

3.gloss: Mum, no more rehearsing. I've quit my job.

answers: 我紧张，我们再练一次吧。
alts.gloss: I'm nervous. Let's go through it once more.

steps.en: Your mum peels an orange and gives you half. 林老师 bills for the oranges. 🍊

else.en: Take two. Your mum plays herself, word-perfect. 林老师 writes: 不用改。 🍊
